name: k01-factory-dawn
prompt: A wide establishing shot at dawn of an Indian beverage factory's loading bay: a long concrete dock under a corrugated roof, pallets of plain kraft cardboard cartons with a sage-green band, two blue trucks backed up to the dock, a supervisor in a yellow hi-vis vest with a clipboard, a worker pushing a pallet jack, mist and low warm sunlight raking across the yard from the right, a water tank on the roof, a tamarind tree beyond the wall. Photorealistic documentary photograph, 35 mm lens, natural light, realistic skin and fabric. No text, no logos, no lettering, no signs anywhere; every pack and carton unbranded.
use: SC-158 keyframe: the first frame of one of the demo film's clips, and the still behind its screens
fictional: every person is fictional; no brand or lettering
